propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on review of unrelated tickets in the same epic.
Empty directories in .tickets-tracker are invisible to git status and cannot be tracked or gitignored, so they persist in local clones and cannot be detected by inspecting shared history.
The error message names the broken ticket (the empty directory), not the ticket being reviewed, creating a wrong-direction signal that obscures the actual root cause.
The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the entire snapshot.
The writer creates ticket directories via os.makedirs before writing the first event, allowing orphaned empty directories to remain if the process dies during the staging-to-rename window.
